correctness.rationale: The three anticanonical cubics cut out exactly the seven points, and at a point with, for example, X nonzero the first derivatives in the Y and Z directions give independent linear terms. Thus -K is nef and big. Adjunction and Cauchy–Schwarz reduce nonexceptional negative curves to degrees at most two (-2) or three (-1). Every five-point subset contains a Fano triple (deleting two points meets only five of seven lines); Bézout eliminates the proposed conics and the cubic with a double point. The remaining curves and their weights are exactly the stated seven of each type. Every three-vertex star has determinant zero, for either choice of center weight; the permitted isolated vertices and edges give negative-definite blocks. Over the finite field a fixed support descends as a reduced effective divisor; the ample-plus-support construction has positive-part null locus exactly the support and gives an interior divisor. An independent enumeration using Fano line triples {a,b,a xor b}, all incidence-preserving point permutations and admissible point/line pairs reproduced all five size polynomials, the 54 group orbits with multiplicities (3,10,8,12,4,16,1), and centralizer order seven for each of the 48 order-seven elements. All seven points and, separately, all seven lines are transitive under an order-seven element, so exactly the two pure supports and the nef support survive. The result is only for the specified collineation twists, not graph dualities. Replay: python3 /workspace/branches/independent_arithmetic.py. The frozen verifier was inspected, not run.

value.rationale: For a distinguished weak del Pezzo surface, a complete negative-component classification for every collineation twist gives a precise arithmetic invariant of its big cone, including order-seven disappearance of every intermediate support size. The 54-orbit stabilizer spectrum gives the symmetry types of the full support family. These are meaningful for chambers of divisors over the base field; the already known untwisted 2257 count and known signed homology character do not supply those two classifications.
